(Published September 4, 2012 with nice images; archived by the Wayback Machine on May 30, 2015 and later deleted.) :''Macronix'' MX25L1606EM2I-12G 16Mbit (2MB) Serial Flash :''[[Samsung]]'' K9F1G08U0D 1Gbit (128MB) NAND Flash :[[Broadcom]] BCM53125 switch, ''[[SMSC]]'' USB25148 USB 2.0 Hub :''[[Foxconn]]'' P/N T77H391 BCM4360 wireless module (same P/N and :[[Broadcom]] ref. design for the BCM4352 module in the [[Netgear R6200]]) :silkscreened with "BCM94360MCH5" and the [[Foxconn]] P/N "T77H391" :noted the dies for the BCM4360 and BCM4352 as being the same. ==Links of Interest== :[https://web.archive.org/web/20181015040748if_/https://www.netgear.com/R6300 Product page ''(archived at EoL)''] {{SupportPage|vendor=NETGEAR|model = r6300v1|vs_id=20789}} {{•}} [https://www.downloads.netgear.com/files/GDC/R6300/R6300_UM_18Jun12.pdf User Manual] {{•}} [https://kb.netgear.com/23899/Comparison-between-different-versions-of-the-R6300 Official comparison between v1 and v2 models] ===Reviews=== * [https://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/first-look-netgear-r6300-wifi-router-80211ac-dual-band-gigabit/ ''First Look: NETGEAR R6300 WiFi Router-802.11ac Dual Band Gigabit''] by Tim Higgins on '''SmallNetBuilder''' :Default SSIDs of NETGEAR57 and NETGEAR57-5G * [https://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/netgear-r6300-wifi-router-80211ac-dual-band-gigabit-full-review/ ''NETGEAR R6300 WiFi Router-802.11ac Dual Band Gigabit Full Review''] by Tim Higgins on '''SmallNetBuilder''' :indicates the switch chip is a [[Broadcom]] BCM53115 ::(contradicted by the ''SkyWorks'' dissection below) :2.4GHz - [[Broadcom]] BCM4331 + 3x [[Skyworks]] SE2594L ::(Dual Band 802.11a/b/g/n Wireless LAN Front End) :5GHz - [[Broadcom]] BCM4360 + 3x [[Skyworks]] SE5003L ::(5GHz, 23dBm Power Amp w/ Power Detector) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20211025144537if_/https://foxnetlab.com/index.php/16-reviews/88-ac-for-all-or-netgear-r6300 ''"AC for All" or NETGEAR R6300'' review] on '''Foxnetwork''' : 84:1B:5E OUI; NETGEARXX and NETGEARXX-5G SSIDs : (Published in 2013 with internal and external photos plus UI screenshots; archived by the Wayback Machine on October 25, 2021 and later deleted.) ===Forum threads=== * [https://web.archive.org/web/20150404050427if_/http://www.myopenrouter.com/article/46049/Inside-the-NETGEAR-R6300-JTAG-Pinouts-USB-TTL-Extension-Pics...-Plus-DD-WRT-Kong-Mod-is-Coming/ ''Inside the NETGEAR R6300: JTAG Pinouts, USB-TTL Extension, Pics... Plus DD-WRT Kong Mod is Coming!''] on '''MyOpenRouter''' : (Published by Kong on February 26, 2013; archived by the Wayback Machine on April 4, 2015 and later deleted.) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20160611100516if_/http://www.dd-wrt.pl/forum/viewtopic.php?p=871333 ''NETGEAR R6300 BRECIKED[sic] OR SOFT BRICKED?''] shot of the header section on the '''DD-WRT Forum''' : (Posted by addpinto on January 7, 2014; archived by the Wayback Machine on June 11, 2016 and later deleted.) ===Other=== * [https://www.anandtech.com/show/5836/netgear-announces-2stream-80211ac-r6200-router-and-a6200-usb-20-adapter ''Netgear Announces 2-stream 802.11ac R6200 router and A6200 USB 2.0 adapter''] on '''AnandTech''' :Processor noted as the [[Broadcom]] BCM4706 ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing dd-wrt=== {{DDWRT |techdata = |wikipage = |forumpage = |forumpage2 = |forumpage3 = |github = |target = |subtarget = |arch = |support_started_version = ? |current_supported_version = ? |unsupportedfuncntions = |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/netgear/netgear_r6300_v1 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/netgear/r6300_v1 |forumpage = |forumpage2 = |forumpage3 = |github = |target = bcm47xx |subtarget = mips74k |arch = mipsel_74kc |support_started_version = 17.01.0 |current_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = [https://openwrt.org/unsupported/wifi_2.4ghz_partly WiFi 2.4GHz partly], [https://openwrt.org/unsupported/wifi_5ghz WiFi 5GHz] |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ===Flashing Tomato=== Please insert instructions here ==JTAG-Serial Info== ===JTAG=== ====JTAG Pinouts==== J251 (presumably JTAG) ===Serial=== ====Serial Pinouts==== The serial header is '''J252'''.
